# IMPERIA COLD WAR — 1970 focus and legacy mechanic corrections.
# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Israel 1970 national programmes.
# MD Cold War | Israel 1970. Generated by tools/israel_1970/build_content.py.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			ISR = {
				if = {
					limit = { ISR70_is_scenario = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_initialized } } # COLDWAR ISR 1970
					ISR70_initialize = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { ISR70_is_scenario = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_ISR_initialized } } # COLDWAR ISR 1970
				ISR70_refresh_programmes = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
